Teen granted bail in Brisbane murder case

A 15-year-old, initially charged with robbery and grievous bodily harm, was granted bail in Brisbane. The charges were later upgraded to murder after a man died in August. Sentencing is expected for the teen, who has pleaded guilty to murder.
